subject.title: fix(gateway): make scope errors machine-readable across clients

question: Should this cross-client authorization-contract expansion land after the remaining native platform checks complete, or should its Apple and Android migration be split from the gateway policy and protocol changes?
rationale: The code changes an additive public protocol surface and authorization outcomes across several independently shipped clients; the correct release grouping depends on maintainer ownership of the native-client rollout.

options.title: Land as one coordinated authorization update
options.body: Keep the shared protocol, server policy, and client migrations together once native Apple and Android validation passes.

options.title: Split native-client adoption
options.body: Land the protocol and gateway-policy contract separately, then stage Apple and Android consumption in platform-owned follow-up PRs.

recommendation.title: Land as one coordinated authorization update
recommendation.body: Keep the shared protocol, server policy, and client migrations together once native Apple and Android validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the immediately preceding merged authorization contract and authored the coordinated follow-up.
